name: Filaxix
summary: Amazon filament brand focused on PETG variants (standard, matte rapid, carbon-fibre, glass-fibre), plus ASA and nylon carbon-fibre, at about $14-28/kg for 1 kg spools. The Amazon seller is a Huizhou technology company; extruder unknown.

product_lines.name: PETG Matte Rapid
product_lines.notes: 1 kg, $18.04-22.99; a matte high-speed grade; there is no specific id for matte PETG.
